analyst_view.overall: Borac (21st, 3 pts, beaten 2-0 at Mjallby last time out) host Atalanta (16th, 4 pts) in a game both need for a top-24 place. Atalanta drew 4-4 with Inter on Sunday, scoring four but conceding a Pio Esposito hat-trick, and lost first-choice keeper Marco Carnesecchi in the warm-up: tests showed a torn meniscus and he has surgery on Tuesday, so Sportiello should start in Banja Luka; the numbers already count that (+6% to Borac's goals). Sarri's side also had centre-backs Hien and Kossounou out recently (Scalvini and Kolasinac started against Inter), and they play Lecce on 30 November, so some rotation is possible. Borac, under Vinko Marinovic, play an open game at home, and the numbers already count both sides' recent form (Atalanta conceding a lot, Borac collecting cards). No referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, with Atalanta scoring about 2, already lifted for Borac's recent scoring and for Carnesecchi's absence (+6%). The 4-4 with Inter shows Atalanta can score and concede freely, but that is the same open picture the numbers already carry, and possible rotation pulls the other way, so I stay at about 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, about 6 for Atalanta. Atalanta should have most of the ball and Borac have been conceding plenty of corners, which the numbers already add through recent form (+7% for Atalanta). Nothing in the news changes Atalanta's wide play, so I stay at about 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, and they already raise Borac's share by about 19% for their recent card count. A home side chasing a stronger team tends to foul more, but that is what the numbers already show, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.1 shots, 19 of them Atalanta's, already lifted for both sides' recent volume. I lean slightly lower: after a draining 4-4 with Inter and with Lecce next, Sarri may rotate and manage the game rather than chase it, which the numbers can't see. A mild -3% gives about 31.1 shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target, already raised for both sides' recent accuracy. Krstovic, Atalanta's main scorer, should start whoever else rotates, and a stand-in keeper and Borac's open defence both point to chances at each end, which the numbers already count, so I stay at about 10.7.
